description: Stop a queued or running background product bulk job. Batches already applied stay applied - a cancel does not undo them; no further batch runs. The job ends `failed` with failureReason `cancelled` and is not resumable. Needs the permission that starts a job of that kind (models:delete for a delete job, models:edit for an update job).

jobId.description: The job id a start_bulk_*_products tool or get_product_bulk_job returned

name: cancel_product_bulk_job
title: Cancel product bulk job
